purpose: Operational source-readiness map for behavioural-mechanism research. It ranks only the next admissible empirical action; it is not a ranking of economic importance, model truth, causal evidence or validation status.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Monitor future BNR policy-rate decisions only; open event-month MIR response values solely under the prospective confirmation contract after a non-zero event and official release.
blockers: No non-zero policy-rate event yet in the reserved prospective window.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Reopen only if an official/reproducible source supplies same-boundary opening principal and matched refinancing/reset rates across material debt blocks.
blockers: Opening principal, realized repriced principal, and matched old/new rates are not available on a reconciled public boundary.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Enumerate and retain exact official BNR BLS XLS/XLSX rounds and hashes, then materialize realised NFC and household credit-standards and loan-demand histories separately together with harmonised NPL/capital controls.
blockers: Official BNR BLS spreadsheets are identified but provider access and complete historical enumeration remain unresolved.

Quarterly Romania NPL and CET1 series are confirmed in ECB CBD2; the preregistered I4001 solvency-ratio Romania tuple still requires live coverage evidence and a population/consolidation bridge before use.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Do not open 2021-01..2026-06 final evaluation and do not respecify transforms, AR order, FX lag blocks, external-price lags, regime dummies or asymmetry on this evidence cycle. Reopen only through a separately preregistered cycle justified by genuinely new measurement or identification evidence, such as an exact Romania transaction-price import-price index, an independently justified exogenous FX-shock design, or new regime-identification evidence.
blockers: The preregistered FX candidate failed structural selection before holdout.
Incremental RMSE improvement over the mandatory external-price baseline was approximately 0.014%, below the preregistered 2% gate.
The FX candidate underperformed the AR(2)+seasonal baseline on RMSE and was slightly worse than the external-price baseline on MAE.
Positive cumulative FX sign consistency and good conditioning were insufficient to overcome the predictive-gain failures.
The 2021-01..2026-06 final-evaluation window remains unopened and cannot be used to rescue or respecify this cycle.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Do not open 2023-Q1..2026-Q1 final-evaluation performance and do not respecify on the same evidence cycle. Reopen sovereign-yield modelling only under a separately preregistered cycle triggered by genuinely new measurement or identification evidence, such as an exact retained domestic policy-rate vintage or an independently justified issuance/refinancing observable.
blockers: The preregistered fiscal-augmented common-market AR form failed structural selection before holdout.
Its RMSE was worse than both persistence and the common-market AR baseline.
The preregistered fiscal coefficient sign-consistency gates failed.
Post-result lag search, variable addition, sign changes or final-holdout inspection are prohibited in this cycle.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Do not manually copy or chart-digitize DSTI values. Reopen household-consumption measurement only when a deterministic reviewed extraction path can identify the relevant BNR workbook sheet/range and preserve new-loan versus outstanding-loan semantics.
blockers: Seven exact official BNR BLS workbook files from 2023-2025 are retained with immutable hashes.
The workbooks are legacy OLE2 .xls files; no canonical deterministic value-extraction path has yet been admitted.
Borrower-level new-loan versus outstanding-loan DSTI must remain separate and neither is automatically equivalent to the registered macro household DSR.
Household borrowing-rate family and consumption/income real/seasonal transformations remain unfrozen.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Do not open the 2024-Q1..2026-Q1 final-evaluation window and do not respecify lags, signs, predictors, target, rate family, interactions or regimes on this evidence cycle. Reopen only through a separately preregistered cycle triggered by genuinely new measurement or identification evidence.
blockers: The preregistered core lagged-driver investment-rate form failed structural selection before holdout.
Its RMSE was worse than both persistence and the estimated investment-rate AR benchmark.
The financing-rate coefficient violated the preregistered non-positive domain at every structural-selection origin (domain-consistency fraction 0.0).
The preregistered support-augmented extension also failed and did not improve on the core form.
The untouched 2024-Q1..2026-Q1 final-evaluation window may not be opened to rescue this cycle.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Search for an exact Romania borrower debt-service burden on a portfolio boundary compatible with the NPL target; separately preregister aggregate versus sector-specific NPL and the activity variable before any estimation.
blockers: Exact quarterly Romania CBD2 NPL ratio is available from 2014-Q4.
Romania is not among the 17 economies in the current BIS documentation with household/NFC sectoral DSR breakdowns.
BNR household DSTI is borrower/loan-portfolio specific and is not aligned to an aggregate or NFC-inclusive NPL target.
Output-growth observable and aggregate versus sector-specific NPL target remain unfrozen.
Lag structure and treatment of regulatory/portfolio-management breaks remain unresolved.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Do not open 2018-2024 final evaluation and do not respecify the annual fiscal-reaction form on the same evidence cycle. Reopen only through a separately preregistered cycle justified by genuinely new measurement or identification evidence, such as a cyclically adjusted primary-balance vintage, longer real-time historical vintages, or an independently justified regime/identification design.
blockers: The preregistered lagged-state annual candidate failed structural selection before holdout.
Candidate RMSE was worse than naive primary-balance persistence over 2010-2017.
The preregistered non-negative output-gap coefficient domain failed at every expanding-origin fit.
The 2018-2024 final-evaluation window remains unopened and cannot be used to rescue or respecify this cycle.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Keep the policy rate observed/exogenous for early validation. Before any reaction-function estimation, preregister an inflation-gap/activity-gap measurement boundary, an expectations source, policy-regime dates and an identification strategy for simultaneous policy responses.
blockers: Observed policy-rate history alone does not identify a policy reaction function.
Inflation gap and activity gap require target/potential-output measurement choices.
Inflation expectations source and horizon are not frozen.
Managed-float intervention and regime changes create simultaneous/endogenous policy responses.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Search official sources for debt currency denomination plus residual-maturity/refinancing timing on compatible S13/bank/other-sector boundaries and an explicit hedging treatment. Do not infer FX exposure from EUR/RON reporting units.
blockers: ECB BPS provides Romania external-debt stocks by sector and original-maturity categories.
Confirmed BPS series retain currency denominator _T = All currencies; reporting in EUR or RON does not reveal contractual currency denomination.
Original maturity does not identify residual maturity or principal due in the next quarter.
Hedging and matched debt-service schedules remain unobserved on the aggregate boundary.

priority_rule: Priority is determined by the shortest scientifically admissible path to new independent evidence, not by a desire to activate a feedback loop. Waiting mechanisms remain frozen; source-incomplete mechanisms are not fit with proxies.

current_next_step.reason: The household DSTI source bytes are now retained but canonical extraction is a tooling/measurement boundary. The bank-credit mechanism already has a preregistered ECB CBD2 prudential coverage diagnostic that can add independent source evidence without parsing BNR workbooks or fitting a credit equation.

coverage_rule.rule: Every mechanism whose registry classification is CANDIDATE, DEFERRED or ACTIVATED must have exactly one source-readiness entry. REJECTED shortcuts are excluded because they have no admissible estimation path unless separately reopened.
